description.message: Chooses the privacy level: Standard or Advanced (hides your time zone). Shows what each level does not hide.

pl_lead.message: How much of what sites use to recognise your device Klin hides. Each level says what it does not hide and what it costs.

pl_standard_line.message: Standard: blocks trackers and makes your device harder to recognise. Sites keep working.

pl_standard_does.message: Blocks advertising and trackers, keeps cookies apart per site, adds noise to the canvas read-out, hides the local network address, trims referrers.

pl_standard_hides.message: Does not hide your time zone, screen size, languages, processor count, fonts or audio fingerprint. Sites see your IP address.

pl_standard_cost.message: None. This is the level for most people.

pl_advanced_line.message: Advanced: hides your time zone. Does not hide your screen size.

pl_advanced_does.message: Everything in Standard, and pages see UTC as your time zone.

pl_advanced_hides.message: Does not hide screen and window size, touch, languages, processor count, fonts or audio fingerprint. Sites see your IP address. It is an approximation done inside the page: a page that looks hard can notice it, and background workers are not covered.

pl_advanced_cost.message: Times on booking and calendar sites can appear shifted by one or two hours. One click back to Standard.

pl_maximum_line.message: Maximum: Advanced plus Tor and nothing kept on disk. Not available yet.

pl_maximum_does.message: The full set of Firefox's fingerprint protections, traffic through Tor, no persistent data.

pl_maximum_hides.message: Not available: Tor is not part of Klin yet. Even then sites will not see your IP address, but Klin will not call this anonymous.

pl_maximum_cost.message: Slower. Some sites refuse Tor or break.

pl_no1.message: ==None of them makes you anonymous.== Sites see your IP address and your provider sees which sites you contact. Only a tool such as Tor changes that, and Tor is not part of Klin yet.

pl_no2.message: None of them hides what you give away: logging in, filling forms, uploading files.

pl_no3.message: A change applies to pages you load or reload afterwards. It does not undo what a site already learned.
